title: How the Atlantis story passed from Solon to Critias

tellings.quote: I believe it was um Solon to Dropus to Critius the Elder to Critius the Younger who then presented the story at the Socratic forum.

plain: The story of Atlantis, the lost island civilization, is said to have come from Egyptian priests to Solon, a lawmaker of ancient Athens, then passed from Solon to Dropides, to Critias the Elder, and to Critias the Younger, who told it at a gathering with Socrates that the philosopher Plato wrote down. The researcher Randall Carlson traces this chain for Michels from memory, without naming a source. If the chain holds, Plato's Atlantis would be a handed-down record, not just a made-up tale.
